instruction: Have Glitch plug the data shard into his deck and crack whatever is on it.

target.reason: The instruction's end state is the data shard being plugged into Glitch's deck and cracked, but the page offers no verb for using, plugging in, or cracking an item — only depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, and refuse. Getting Glitch to hold the shard ( Rogue offers, Glitch accepts) would only put the item in his hand; nothing on the page can reach the state of it being cracked, so none of the available end states carries out the instruction.
